options_hindi: सेवानिवृत्ति की तारीख से एक महीने पहले
सेवानिवृत्ति की तारीख से तीन महीने पहले
सेवानिवृत्ति की तारीख से छह महीने पहले

questions.question_english: A Principal is approaching superannuation in four months. Under the GPF Rules, when must the mandatory monthly subscription to their GPF account be stopped?
options_english: One month before the date of superannuation
Three months before the date of superannuation
Six months before the date of superannuation
The subscription continues until the last month of service
questions.explanation_english: In accordance with the General Provident Fund Rules, monthly subscriptions to the GPF account must be mandatorily stopped three months prior to the date of superannuation of the subscriber. This mandatory stoppage facilitates seamless administrative reconciliation, interest computation, and timely final disbursement of accumulated balances upon retirement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। सामान्य भविष्य निधि नियमों के अनुसार, जीपीएफ खाते में मासिक योगदान सेवानिवृत्ति की तारीख से तीन महीने पहले अनिवार्य रूप से रोकना चाहिए। यह अनिवार्य रोक प्रशासनिक समन्वय, ब्याज की गणना और सेवानिवृत्ति पर संचित शेष राशि के समय पर अंतिम वितरण को सुगम बनाती है।
key_facts: General Provident Fund Rules mandate stopping subscriptions three months before superannuation.
Facilitates administrative reconciliation and timely disbursement.
Printed answer key: (B) Three months before the date of superannuation

questions.question_english: An employee appointed in 1999 applies for voluntary retirement after 21 years of service. How is the calculation of their pension affected compared to superannuation at age 60?
options_english: A strict penalty deduction of 2% for every year of shortfall from the standard superannuation age of 60 is applied to pension.
Pension is calculated only based on last pay drawn.
There is no change in pension calculation.
Pension is calculated based on actual qualifying service and last pay drawn, without penalty.
questions.explanation_english: The correct option is 'd'. When a government servant retires voluntarily after completing twenty years of qualifying service under Rule 43 of CCS Pension Rules, pension is calculated based on their actual qualifying service and basic pay drawn. No penalty deductions or shortfalls are levied for retiring prior to reaching sixty years of superannuation age.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। जब एक सरकारी कर्मचारी स्वैच्छिक रूप से बीस वर्षों की योग्यता सेवा पूरी करने के बाद सेवानिवृत्त होता है, तो पेंशन उनकी वास्तविक योग्यता सेवा और अंतिम वेतन के आधार पर की जाती है। 60 वर्ष की सुपरएन्यूएशन आयु से पहले सेवानिवृत्त होने पर कोई दंड कटौती या कमी नहीं लगाई जाती।
key_facts: Rule 43 of CCS Pension Rules allows voluntary retirement after 20 years of service.
No penalty for retiring before the age of 60.
Printed answer key: (D) Pension is calculated based on actual qualifying service and last pay drawn, without penalty.

questions.question_english: If a pensioner is convicted of a serious crime by a court of law post-retirement, what action can the President take under the CCS (Pension) Rules?
options_english: No administrative action can be taken under rules as the employee has already formally retired.
The pension is temporarily suspended during the jail term and resumed with full arrears upon release.

questions.explanation_english: If a pensioner is convicted of a serious crime by a court of law post-retirement, the President of India has statutory authority under CCS Pension Rules to order the withholding or withdrawal of pension, either in full or in part, and either permanently or for a specified fixed duration.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। यदि एक पेंशनर को सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद किसी गंभीर अपराध में अदालत द्वारा दोषी ठहराया जाता है, तो भारत के राष्ट्रपति के पास CCS पेंशन नियमों के तहत पेंशन को पूर्ण या आंशिक रूप से रोकने या वापस लेने का वैधानिक अधिकार है, चाहे वह स्थायी रूप से हो या एक निर्दिष्ट अवधि के लिए।
key_facts: CCS Pension Rules provide the President authority to withhold pension for serious crimes.

questions.question_english:
What happens to the NPS tier I account of a government servant who is dismissed from service?
(A) The entire accumulated corpus, including both employee and employer contributions with returns, is confiscated by the government.
(B) The employer’s contribution is confiscated by the state, and only the employee’s own contribution remains.
(C) Treated as premature exit: 20% lump sum.
(D) It is completely forfeited.
options_english: The entire accumulated corpus, including both employee and employer contributions with returns, is confiscated by the government.
The employer’s contribution is confiscated by the state, and only the employee’s own contribution remains.
Treated as premature exit: 20% lump sum.
questions.explanation_english: When an NPS-covered government servant is dismissed or removed from service, their exit from the pension system is treated as a premature exit under PFRDA regulations. Consequently, 20% of the total accumulated wealth can be withdrawn as a lump sum, while the remaining 80% must be used to purchase an annuity. This ensures that the employee receives a portion of their savings while also securing a steady income for retirement.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। जब एक NPS से जुड़े सरकारी कर्मचारी को बर्खास्त किया जाता है, तो उनकी पेंशन प्रणाली से निकासी को PFRDA नियमों के तहत समय से पूर्व निकासी के रूप में माना जाता है। परिणामस्वरूप, संचित कुल धन का 20% एकमुश्त निकासी के रूप में लिया जा सकता है, जबकि शेष 80% को वार्षिकी खरीदने के लिए उपयोग करना आवश्यक है। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि कर्मचारी अपनी बचत का एक हिस्सा प्राप्त करे और साथ ही सेवानिवृत्ति के लिए एक स्थिर आय भी सुरक्षित करे।
key_facts: PFRDA regulations treat dismissal as a premature exit.
20% lump sum and 80% annuity are mandatory upon premature exit.
Printed answer key: (C) Treated as premature exit: 20% lump sum.

questions.question_english: A school Principal notices that children from a nearby migrant labor camp are being denied admission by the school’s clerical staff citing a lack of permanent address proof. The Principal intervenes and orders their admission. Which fundamental principle of the UDHR is the Principal most directly upholding in this administrative action?
options_english: Article 2: Non-discrimination in the enjoyment of rights
Article 13: Freedom of movement and residence
Article 23: Right to work and free choice of employment
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Article 2, which emphasizes non-discrimination in the enjoyment of rights. By ensuring that children from the migrant labor camp are admitted to school despite lacking permanent address proof, the Principal is upholding their right to education without discrimination. This action aligns with the principles of equality and non-discrimination as outlined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। अनुच्छेद 2, जो अधिकारों के आनंद में अविभाजन पर जोर देता है, सही उत्तर है। प्रवासी श्रमिक शिविर के बच्चों को स्थायी पता प्रमाण के अभाव में विद्यालय में प्रवेश देने से वंचित नहीं करना, प्रधानाचार्य का यह कदम उनके शिक्षा के अधिकार की रक्षा करता है। यह कार्रवाई मानवाधिकारों की सार्वभौमिक घोषणा में वर्णित समानता और अविभाजन के सिद्धांतों के अनुरूप है।
key_facts: Article 2 of the UDHR emphasizes non-discrimination.
Right to education is a fundamental human right.
Printed answer key: (A) Article 2: Non-discrimination in the enjoyment of rights.

questions.question_english: A PGT under NPS resigns from Delhi government service at the age of 45 after serving for 15 years. Which of the following dictates their NPS withdrawal protocol?
options_english: They are eligible to withdraw 100% of the entire accumulated pension corpus as a lump sum immediately upon resignation.
Premature exit rules apply: at least 80% must purchase a life annuity and up to 20% as lump sum.
They must wait until attaining the standard superannuation age of 60 to access any portion of the accumulated funds.
They are permitted to withdraw 60% as a tax-free lump sum and must purchase a mandatory life annuity with the remaining 40%.
questions.explanation_english: Premature exit rules apply: at least 80% must purchase a life annuity and up to 20% as lump sum. When an NPS subscriber resigns from government service before reaching superannuation, the resignation is treated as a premature exit under PFRDA regulations. In a premature exit, the subscriber must utilize at least eighty percent of the accumulated pension wealth to purchase a mandatory life annuity, leaving up to twenty percent as a lump sum.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। अवधि पूर्व निकासी नियम लागू होते हैं: कम से कम 80% को जीवन वार्षिकी खरीदने के लिए और 20% एकमुश्त के रूप में। जब एक NPS सदस्य सरकारी सेवा से इस्तीफा देता है, तो इसे PFRDA नियमों के तहत एक पूर्व-समाप्ति के रूप में माना जाता है। पूर्व-समाप्ति में, सदस्य को संचित पेंशन धन का कम से कम अस्सी प्रतिशत अनिवार्य जीवन वार्षिकी खरीदने के लिए उपयोग करना होगा, जबकि बीस प्रतिशत एकमुश्त के रूप में निकाला जा सकता है।
key_facts: PFRDA regulations govern premature exit from NPS.
At least 80% of the corpus must be used for annuity purchase.
Printed answer key: (b) Premature exit rules apply: at least 80% must purchase a life annuity and up to 20% as lump sum.
